text.text: Ye shall not eat of any thing that dieth of itself: thou shalt give it unto the stranger that is in thy gates, that he may eat it; or thou mayest sell it unto an alien: for thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.
Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch; they are unclean to you.
That which dieth of itself, or is torn with beasts, he shall not eat to defile himself therewith: I am the Lord.
